tooling.python: 3.11.9 (python --version observed before generation; no backend execution)
tooling.browser: Not used by source discovery; Task 2 records its own browser/build provenance
tooling.backend_mode: Not started or contacted by source discovery; Task 2 isolated mocked API only

fixture_provenance: No runtime fixture consumed by source discovery. Source/config bytes are hashed only; no credential/config payload values copied. Task 2 must hash actual fixtures separately.

independent_route_census.method: git ls-tree baseline frontend/app, filter entry basenames and exclude __tests__; compare exact ordered set with filesystem/AST census

numeric_correctness: Not evaluated: source evidence is discovery and lane handoff, never arithmetic/persistence certification.

baseline_file_validation.method: Each tracked source/config byte sequence is compared to the baseline Git blob SHA-1; Windows CRLF-to-LF canonicalization accepted only when it produces the exact baseline blob. SHA-256 records retain actual checkout bytes.
